readme:
## README.md
# Date geospațiale naționale ale Republicii Moldova

**RO.** Catalog cloud-native cu date selectate din geoportalul național
[geodata.gov.md](https://geodata.gov.md). Româna este limba de referință.
Textele în rusă și engleză sunt traduceri. Catalogul nu este o publicație
oficială a AGCC.

**RU.** Облачный каталог избранных данных национального геопортала
[geodata.gov.md](https://geodata.gov.md). Румынский текст является основным;
русский и английский тексты — переводы. Каталог не является официальной
публикацией AGCC.

**EN.** A cloud-native catalog of selected data from Moldova’s national
geoportal, [geodata.gov.md](https://geodata.gov.md). Romanian is authoritative;
Russian and English are translations. This is not an official AGCC publication.

## Conținut / Содержание / Contents

The catalog provides downloadable vector data as GeoParquet and PMTiles. It
covers cadastral parcels, buildings, addresses, administrative units, the 2017
base map, CORINE land cover, forestry, flood models, utilities, grids, and the
national geodetic network.

This is a curated catalog, not a complete copy of the portal. Large renderer
label layers and superseded linework are excluded. The reasons and measured
counts are recorded in [known issues](https://github.com/nlebovits/moldova-geodata/blob/main/docs/known-issues.md).

Collections named `wms_*` contain links to live WMS layers, not downloadable
data. WFS or WCS access is unavailable for those layers.

## Coordinate system

GeoParquet files preserve MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026), a projected CRS
measured in metres. PMTiles use Web Mercator because web tiles require it.

Do not apply WGS84 coordinates directly to EPSG:4026 geometries. Transform the
query geometry or transform the data explicitly.

## Access

DuckDB can read the published GeoParquet files directly:

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

SELECT *
FROM read_parquet(
  'https://data.source.coop/nlebovits/moldova-geodata/'
  || 'cadastru/uat2/cadastru_data_uat2.parquet'
)
LIMIT 10;
```

Large files include a `bbox` column and GeoParquet covering metadata. Add a
`bbox` predicate before an exact spatial predicate so DuckDB can skip unrelated
row groups. Collection agent guides contain examples based on measured schemas.

## License

The catalog uses CC-BY-4.0 with attribution to the Agenția Geodezie, Cartografie
și Cadastru (AGCC) and technical operator Î.S. INGEOCAD.

The source publishes no license text. It reports `Fees: NONE` and
`AccessConstraints: NONE`. CC-BY-4.0 is the mirror’s assertion and has not been
confirmed by AGCC. WMS-only collections link to material served directly by
AGCC; the mirror claims no ownership of that material.

## Provenance and corrections

Metadata and build tools are maintained at
[github.com/nlebovits/moldova-geodata](https://github.com/nlebovits/moldova-geodata).
Source wording and measured data take precedence over translations. Corrections
to Romanian, Russian, or English terminology are welcome as pull requests.
